heading_fil: Mula sa pansin, tungo sa mungkahi
display_fil:
Tiyak na pansin
Isang unang hakbang
May dahilan at follow-up
display_en:
Specific concern
One first step
Reason and follow-up
narration_fil:
Sa naunang aralin, sinuri ni BHW Mimi ang nakabukas na ilaw at fan sa bakanteng meeting area. Sa pagpapatuloy ng kathang-isip na kuwento, nakumpirma niyang may susunod na gawain doon; hindi niya ito basta pinatay. Napag-alaman ding walang malinaw na paalala kung sino ang titingin sa schedule pagkatapos ng meeting.

Ngayon, bubuo siya ng isang mungkahing maisasagawa: isang maliit na unang hakbang na may dahilan, naaayon sa lokal na tuntunin at hindi nakasasagabal sa serbisyo. Hindi pa ito pahintulot na kumilos o pangakong makatitipid. Opsyonal ang kuwento; maaaring tapusin ang Read o Slides nang hindi nanonood.
narration_en:
In the previous lesson, BHW Mimi checked why the lights and fan were on in an empty meeting area. In this fictional continuation, she confirms another activity is scheduled there; she does not simply turn them off. She also learns there is no clear reminder of who checks the schedule after a meeting.

Now she will form one workable suggestion: a small first step with a reason, consistent with local rules and service needs. It is not yet permission to act or a promise of savings. The story is optional; you can complete Read or Slides without watching it.

display_fil:
Ano · Saan · Kailan
Ano na ang nakumpirma?
Ano pa ang hindi alam?
display_en:
What · Where · When
What is confirmed?
What is still unknown?
narration_fil:
Sinabi ni Mimi: “Pagkatapos ng meeting, nakabukas ang ilaw at fan sa meeting area. Nakumpirma kong may susunod na gawain, pero wala pang malinaw na paalala kung sino ang titingin sa schedule.” Ito ang concern na tatalakayin, hindi paratang na may pabaya.

Kung gagawa ng tala, ilagay ang petsa, oras, lugar at napansin ayon sa lokal na proseso. Sabihin ang hindi pa alam, gaya ng umiiral na checklist o itinalagang tungkulin. Huwag maglagay ng datos ng pasyente, hula sa motibo o halagang matitipid na hindi nasukat.
narration_en:
Mimi says: “After the meeting, the lights and fan were on in the meeting area. I confirmed another activity was scheduled, but there was no clear reminder of who checks the schedule.” This is the concern to discuss, without accusing anyone of carelessness.

If a record is needed, include the date, time, place and observation using the local process. State what remains unknown, such as an existing checklist or assigned duty. Omit patient data, guesses about motives and savings amounts that have not been measured.

display_fil:
Maikling meeting-end checklist
Tingnan ang susunod na schedule
Ipaalam sa itinalagang contact
display_en:
Short meeting-end checklist
Check the next scheduled use
Inform the designated contact
narration_fil:
Iminungkahi ni Mimi: “Maaari po bang suriin natin kung kailangan ng maikling meeting-end checklist para matingnan ng itinalagang tao ang susunod na schedule at maipaalam ang concern sa tamang contact?” Isang panukala lamang ito; hindi niya inaangkin ang tungkulin o nag-uutos na sundin agad ang checklist.

Tiyakin kung may umiiral nang paraan bago gumawa ng bago. Kung mayroon, maaaring linawin lamang ang paalala. Kung kailangan ng pagbabago, alamin ang oras, materyales at taong maaaring gumawa nito. Huwag isama ang sariling pagkumpuni, pagbawas ng clinical supplies o bagong gawain na lampas sa tungkulin.
narration_en:
Mimi proposes: “Could we review whether a short meeting-end checklist is needed, so the designated person checks the next scheduled use and shares concerns with the right contact?” It is one proposal; she does not claim the duty or tell everyone to use the checklist immediately.

Check for an existing process before creating another. If one exists, clarifying its reminder may be enough. If a change is needed, check the time, materials and person who could carry it out. Do not include independent repairs, reductions in clinical supplies or new tasks beyond the role.

display_fil:
Malinaw na schedule at handover
May oras at materyales ba?
Protektahan ang serbisyo
display_en:
Clear schedule and handover
Time and materials available?
Protect service needs
narration_fil:
Dahilan ni Mimi: “Makakatulong ang malinaw na paalala upang hindi malimutan ang pagtingin sa schedule at pag-ugnayan pagkatapos ng meeting.” Layunin nitong bawasan ang kalituhan sa responsibilidad; hindi pa nasusukat kung may matitipid na kuryente o pera.

Itatanong niya kung praktikal ang checklist, sino ang may oras para rito, at kung may susunod na gumagamit ng lugar. Dapat naaayon ito sa tuntunin at hindi nakaaabala sa serbisyo o kaligtasan. Kung may posibleng panganib, idulog sa lokal na safety process; hindi kapalit ng repair o clinical procedure ang checklist.
narration_en:
Mimi explains: “A clear reminder could help people remember to check the schedule and coordinate after a meeting.” The purpose is to reduce confusion about responsibility; electricity or money savings have not been measured.

She asks whether the checklist is practical, who has time for it and whether another group needs the area. It must follow the rules and protect service and safety. If a possible hazard is present, use the local safety process; a checklist does not replace a repair or clinical procedure.

display_fil:
Sino ang may saklaw ng pahintulot?
Sino · Ano · Kailan
Ibalita ang status, huwag mangako
display_en:
Who has authority for this change?
Who · What · When
Report status, avoid promises
narration_fil:
Kinumpirma muna ni Mimi kung sino ang responsable sa lugar at sino ang may saklaw na magpahintulot ng pagbabago. Maaaring midwife, facility supervisor o ibang itinalagang tao; depende ito sa lokal na tungkulin at uri ng panukala. Ang pagsang-ayon ng kasamahan ay hindi awtomatikong pahintulot.

Sa fictional na usapan, pumayag ang contact na suriin ang umiiral na proseso kasama ni Mimi sa susunod na meeting. Itinala nila kung sino ang titingin, ano ang susuriin at kailan sila mag-uusap muli. Kung walang desisyon, iuulat ni Mimi ang status at susundin ang lokal na pagdulog. Hindi siya nangangako ng approval, repair o savings, at hindi muna nagpapatupad ng bagong checklist.
narration_en:
Mimi first confirms who is responsible for the area and who has authority to approve a change. It may be the midwife, facility supervisor or another designated person, depending on local roles and the proposal. A colleague agreeing does not automatically give permission.

In the fictional conversation, the contact agrees to review the existing process with Mimi at the next meeting. They record who will check, what will be reviewed and when they will speak again. If there is no decision, Mimi reports the status and follows the local referral process. She does not promise approval, repairs or savings, and does not implement a new checklist yet.

display_fil:
Tiyak na concern + unang hakbang
Dahilan + lokal na pagsusuri
Napagkasunduang follow-up
display_en:
Specific concern + first step
Reason + local checks
Agreed follow-up

check.prompt_fil: Aling tugon ang angkop bago ipatupad ang checklist?
check.prompt_en: Which response is appropriate before implementing the checklist?

options.fil: Ipa-review sa kinumpirmang responsable ang maikling checklist dahil hindi malinaw ang pagtingin sa schedule; tiyakin ang umiiral na paraan, saklaw ng pahintulot at service needs, at magkasundo kung sino ang titingin at kailan muling mag-uusap.
options.en: Ask the confirmed responsible person to review a short checklist because schedule checks are unclear; verify the existing process, authority and service needs, and agree who will review it and when to speak again.

options.fil: Ilagay muna ang checklist at sundin ito sa susunod na meeting para may konkretong resulta bago humingi ng approval.
options.en: Post the checklist and use it at the next meeting to show a concrete result before asking for approval.

options.fil: Hilinging ayusin ng namamahala ang lahat ng problema sa paggamit ng rekurso dahil sayang ang pera, at hintaying may magbalita.
options.en: Ask the supervisor to fix every resource-use problem because money is being wasted, and wait for someone to report back.

check.feedback_fil: Una: tiyak ang concern, may isang panukala at dahilan, at sinusuri ang proseso, pahintulot at serbisyo bago magkasundo sa follow-up. Ikalawa: nagpapatupad na bago maaprubahan; ang magandang intensiyon at trial ay hindi pahintulot. Ikatlo: pangkalahatan ang hiling, may hindi nasukat na claim sa pera, at walang malinaw na unang hakbang o napagkasunduang follow-up.
check.feedback_en: First: it states a specific concern, one proposal and a reason, checks the process, authority and service, and agrees on follow-up. Second: it implements a change before authorization; good intentions and a trial do not give permission. Third: the request is general, claims unmeasured money waste and lacks a clear first step or agreed follow-up.

narration_fil:
Gusto ng isang kasamahan na agad maglagay ng bagong checklist at atasan ang lahat na sundin ito. Aling tugon ni Mimi ang angkop? Piliin ang mungkahing may tiyak na concern, praktikal na unang hakbang, dahilan, lokal na pagsusuri at napagkasunduang follow-up.

Sa sariling sitwasyon, sabihin ang apat: ano ang nakita; ano ang isang panukala; ano ang dapat tiyakin at kanino; at ano ang follow-up na napagkasunduan. Ang online completion ay hindi katumbas ng naobserbahang workplace skill; kailangan pa ng pagsasanay at feedback.
narration_en:
A colleague wants to post a new checklist immediately and tell everyone to follow it. Which response from Mimi is appropriate? Choose the suggestion with a specific concern, practical first step, reason, local checks and an agreed follow-up.

For your own situation, state four things: what you observed; one proposal; what to check and with whom; and the follow-up you agreed. Online completion does not demonstrate observed workplace skill; practice and feedback are still needed.
